purpose: M0.2 U1 remote proof. Not executed. Not a unit of work. Does not replace the executed U2 artifact and does not rerun U2.
semanticsNote: If u1_tasks already exists, the process writes nothing and exits ALREADY_PRESENT. It does not drop tables, delete the database, or modify the U2 tables organizations, tasks, captures, change_log, or platform_batch_guard.

timeout.note: ADR-001 section 6.1 mentions a 5-second lock timeout and does not define it anywhere else in this repo. @libsql/client 0.15.15 Config and transaction(mode) have no timeout argument, and @libsql/hrana-client 0.7.0 exposes none. This runner does not set one and does not hold a transaction open to probe one.

commandNote: Run once. TURSO_SPIKE_AUTH_TOKEN must already be in the environment. Do not pass the token on the command line. npm ci does not need the token. This directory has no .env file.
